featured_reviews.review_text:
Dec '24 Update
Typically, quality Botox treatments applied by skilled professionals should wear off within 4-6 months. It has now been almost 1 year 4 months since my Hair Botox treatment at Entwurf, and it has only partially worn off, as shown in the new photo I’ve uploaded. This reinforces my earlier point that the damaged hair is from the Botox treatment, not previously rebonded hair as the salon claimed in their response.

I am shocked by how my concerns were handled (as you can see in the salon's response). Instead of acknowledging their mistakes or offering a constructive resolution, the salon's response came across as dismissive, defensive, and lacking professionalism. I really do hope this review helps others make an informed decision.

------

Sept '24 Update
@Entwurf: thanks for the response

@Anyone reading this: Please read the salon’s reply & decide if they’ve truly addressed my concerns or if their response includes unclear explanations & excuses. Their tone in the response may give you an insight into how they treat customers & handled my concerns after month 7 when I first raised issues with the Botox treatment & haircut.

In their response:
- They suggested I damaged my hair “elsewhere” just to leave them a negative review
- They claim they gave me a “one-length haircut”, yet the photos I uploaded show multiple layers
- They claim my damaged hair is previously rebonded, but if that were true, both sides would be straight. The photos show curls returning on one (right) side, indicating Botoxed hair that hasn't washed off evenly

Please read their response and make your own judgment.

------
I got Hair Botox done at Entwurf 11.5 months ago when I had half natural curly hair & half rebonded hair. The goal was to slowly chop off the rebonded hair, botox the natural hair which would eventually wash off and blend in with the new fresh curly hair growth.

It's been almost a year since the Botox. I was expecting it to wash off in 4-6 months as commonly stated online & told to me by the stylist at Entwurf when they recommended Botox to me. The left side of my hair (photo attached) is visibly thin and limp, the right side (photo attached) has washed off a bit more and some curls have emerged but even that hair is thin & feels unhealthy. My hair is now puffy - top-heavy with healthy natural hair and thin at the bottom due to the lingering Botox

Unfortunately, what happened next worsened the problem. After 7 months of the Botox, I went back to Entwurf to show them my hair & that the botox has not come off + get a haircut.. My hair was cut into thick layers/ steps making it even more top heavy and bulky and the ends became even more scanty (photo attached). I was expecting a haircut more suitable to my hair type and the goals we initially discussed.
I have been unable to leave my hair open for the past 4 months since the haircut. I'm estimating another 5 - 6 months before the excessively chopped hair grows & levels out enough to leave my hair open again. Overall, it will likely take nearly a year to repair the damage done to my hair by the Botox treatment and the haircut & I am only halfway through that journey now :(
